title: Anthropic’s Public Debut Looms
summary: We all need a break from the Nvidia soap opera, so we’re switching things up today and talking about that other drama percolating in the background—Anthropic’s public debut. The company behind Claudepriced its initial public offeringon Wednesday night at $83 a share, several dollars above its preliminary pricing range, and at a level that values the whole company at around $1.5 trillion.Seeing as this is the first top AI model developer to go public, not to mention the biggest, we’d bet the stock reaches $150 when it opens on Thursday, as everyone and their dog vies for a piece of the action. Of course, if they were smart, they’d hold back. The stock is more than likely to settle lower in the next few days, as the initial burst of exuberance dissipates. As for where the stock will trade in six months, I can’t guess. The crystal ball I ordered online got stolen en route to my apartment—thanks for nothing,FedEx. (The Information on Thursday will livestream a two-hour video discussion on Anthropic’s valuation, tech, cybersecurity strategy, drug discovery ambitions, as well as market movements:Check it out, starting at 11:30 a.m. PT / 2:30 p.m. ET.)
title_es: Anthropic sale a bolsa con valoración de $1.5 billones
bajada: Anthropic, la empresa detrás de Claude, completó su oferta pública inicial a $83 por acción, valorando la compañía en aproximadamente $1.5 billones. Es el primer desarrollador de modelos de IA de primer nivel en salir a bolsa, marcando un hito importante en la maduración de la industria.
bajada_en: Anthropic, the company behind Claude, completed its initial public offering at $83 per share, valuing the company at approximately $1.5 trillion. It's the first top-tier AI model developer to go public, marking a significant milestone in the industry's maturation.

title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
title_es: Microsoft ofrece salida voluntaria a 60K empleados por AI
bajada: El CEO Satya Nadella explicó que los buyouts ofrecidos a 60,000 empleados en octubre buscan realinear la empresa hacia IA, transformando la fuerza laboral en lugar de hacer despidos masivos. Es una estrategia de reorganización empresarial significativa.
bajada_en: CEO Satya Nadella explained that buyouts offered to 60,000 employees in October aim to realign the company toward AI, transforming the workforce rather than conducting mass layoffs. It's a significant corporate reorganization strategy.

title: U.S. Commerce Department Rushed to Clear Nvidia H200 Exports to China
summary: In recent months, Jeffrey Kessler, the official overseeing the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security, has pressured staff to expedite the approval of sales ofNvidia’s H200 graphics processing units to China, according to three people with knowledge of the matter. In some cases, Kessler directed staff at BIS —an agency under the Commerce Department—to approve the exports over objections from other U.S. government departments, two of those people said.The H200, launched in 2023, is an older generation of Nvidia chips that developers can use to train and run AI models. In December 2025, President Donald Trump approved the chip, which is a generation behind Nvidia’s mainstay Blackwell product, for sale to China, after intense lobbying from former CEO Jensen Huang. As part of the approval, Nvidia agreed to give the U.S. government a 25% cut of H200 sales to China.
title_es: EE.UU. acelera exportación de chips Nvidia H200 a China
bajada: El Departamento de Comercio estadounidense presionó para agilizar la aprobación de exportaciones de GPUs H200 de Nvidia a China, según fuentes del gobierno. Este movimiento refleja la tensión geopolítica en torno a la restricción de tecnología de IA.
bajada_en: The U.S. Commerce Department pressured to expedite approval of Nvidia's H200 GPU exports to China, according to government sources. This move reflects geopolitical tensions surrounding AI technology restrictions.

bajada_en: OpenAI publishes research on how coding agents are accelerating AI research speed, identifying where their performance remains uneven. The study provides insights into recursive self-improvement and research automation.

title: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers

bajada: Hugging Face publica optimizaciones para ejecutar modelos de expertos mezclados masivos (180B parámetros) con solo 32GB de RAM. Es un avance técnico importante para hacer accesibles grandes modelos a developers.

title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
summary: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.
title_es: Nadella advierte que infraestructura crítica es 'inparcheable'
bajada: El CEO de Microsoft señala que gran parte de la infraestructura crítica no puede actualizarse, aumentando riesgos ante potenciales ataques cibernéticos impulsados por IA. Subraya desafíos de seguridad que trascienden el reciente apagón de Outlook.
bajada_en: Microsoft's CEO notes that much critical infrastructure cannot be patched, raising risks from potential AI-driven cyberattacks. It underscores security challenges that transcend the recent Outlook outage.

title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
summary: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.
title_es: Nadella: agentes de IA van a remodelar la economía web
bajada: El CEO de Microsoft predice que los agentes de IA disrumpirán modelos publicitarios, forzando a empresas como Amazon a repensar su competencia. Señala un cambio estructural en cómo los usuarios acceden a información y servicios online.
bajada_en: Microsoft's CEO predicts AI agents will disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink competition. It signals structural change in how users access information and online services.

title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
summary: New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago schools are considering Google alternatives after the company said it will disable Search for schools that opt out of its AI features, according to The New York Times. Starting next year, schools will not have the option to disable Gemini-powered features without also disabling Search. Chris Phillips, Google's vice […]
title_es: Grandes distritos escolares consideran abandonar Google Search
bajada: Nueva York, Los Ángeles y Chicago analizan alternativas a Google tras su decisión de forzar características Gemini de IA sin opción de desactivarlas. Genera controversia sobre privacidad estudiantil y control sobre herramientas educativas.
bajada_en: New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago districts consider Google alternatives after the company forces Gemini AI features without opt-out options. It raises concerns about student privacy and control over educational tools.

bajada_en: Hugging Face launched Rumble-2-Flash, a compact 0.5B parameter model for multilingual speech recognition. It offers a lightweight, open-source solution for developers needing audio processing capabilities.

With up to 128GB of unified memory and NVIDIA’s AI software stack, these systems provide room for larger local models alongside RTX-accelerated creative and development […]

bajada_en: OpenAI demonstrates how Codex Sandbox lets developers run commands on local machines with configurable filesystem and network restrictions. It's an important tool for developers seeking security in code agent integration.

title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
